gui.mcagents.title: MCAgents
gui.mcagents.session.delete.title: Delete this chat?
gui.mcagents.session.delete.message: "%s" and every message in it will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
gui.mcagents.keys.title: OpenRouter API keys
gui.mcagents.keys.empty: No keys yet. Add one to let the agent answer.
gui.mcagents.models.title: Models
gui.mcagents.models.embedding.tip.on: Questions are matched against your Knowledge Packs, and the closest are sent with them.
gui.mcagents.models.embedding.tip.off: Questions are sent on their own. Knowledge Packs are not used, and no embedding is charged for.
gui.mcagents.wallets.title: Wallets
gui.mcagents.wallets.none_selected: Pick a wallet on the left
gui.mcagents.wallets.add.tip: A new, empty wallet under this account
gui.mcagents.wallets.delete.title: Delete this wallet?
gui.mcagents.wallets.delete.message: "%s" and every address in it will be removed from this mod. Your wallet itself is untouched. This cannot be undone.
gui.mcagents.wallets.account.add.tip: An account is a name you keep wallets under. Naming a new one creates it.
gui.mcagents.wallets.address.add.tip: Record an address you type. It is not proof — only signing is.
gui.mcagents.wallets.bound.recorded: %s address recorded. It was typed in, not proved.
gui.mcagents.wallets.address.empty: No addresses in this wallet yet
gui.mcagents.wallets.address.label: Public address
gui.mcagents.wallets.address.public_only: Public addresses only. Never paste a private key or recovery phrase — here or anywhere else.
gui.mcagents.wallets.connect.tip: Prove every address MetaMask shares, by signing each one
gui.mcagents.wallets.connect.copied: Link copied. Open it in the browser MetaMask is installed in.
gui.mcagents.wallets.connect.no_browser: Could not open a browser. Copy the link below instead.
gui.mcagents.wallets.connect.never_asks: MCAgents never asks for your recovery phrase or private key.
gui.mcagents.wallets.connect.signing_is_: You will be asked to sign one message per address. Each proves you control that address — it costs nothing, moves nothing, and never reaches a chain.
gui.mcagents.console.title: Web console
gui.mcagents.console.subtitle: Read your packs and chats in a browser
gui.mcagents.console.copied: Address copied. Paste it into the browser you want to read in.
gui.mcagents.console.no_browser: Could not open a browser. Copy the address instead.
gui.mcagents.console.local_only: Served from this machine only. It keeps running when you close this screen, so you can read while you play.
